title: Rank ijk/ikj/jki matmul loop orders by cache misses (real C++)
info: Real C++: runs all three ijk/ikj/jki loop nests of a 24x24 row-major matmul over a fixed set-associative LRU cache model and ranks them by measured misses, compiled by clang++.
reference measured misses: ijk=1097, ikj=1120, jki=3613 -- jki's column-major-style B access thrashes the cache far worse than the other two.
